title: Data Retention Policy
content:
Data Retention Policy v2.1

The Data Retention Policy is owned by the Security Team and applies to all production environments.

All production data must be retained for a minimum of 365 days. After the retention period expires, data must be permanently deleted within 30 days.

The Security Team is responsible for enforcing data deletion schedules. The Engineering Team must implement automated deletion pipelines for all production databases.

Backup data follows the same retention schedule as primary data. Backups older than 365 days must be destroyed.

Data classification levels:
- Public: No retention restrictions
- Internal: 365 days minimum retention
- Confidential: 730 days minimum retention
- Restricted: 1095 days minimum retention

The Compliance Team audits retention compliance quarterly. Any violations must be reported to the Security Team within 24 hours.

Exceptions to this policy require written approval from both the Security Team Lead and the Compliance Team Lead.
